name: Ironwood Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
business_overview: Ironwood Pharmaceuticals, Inc., a biotechnology company, focuses on the development and commercialization of therapies for gastrointestinal (GI) and rare diseases in the United States and internationally. It sells linaclotide, a guanylate cyclase type-C (GC-C) agonist for the treatment of adults suffering from irritable bowel syndrome with constipation or chronic idiopathic constipation, as well as for pediatric patients suffering from functional constipation under the LINZESS and CONSTELLA names. The company is also developing IW-3300, a GC-C agonist for the treatment of visceral pain conditions, including interstitial cystitis/bladder pain syndrome and endometriosis; and Apraglutide, a synthetic peptide long-acting analog of glucagon-like peptide-2 for short bowel syndrome patients dependent on parenteral support, as well as for acute graft versus host disease. It has strategic partnerships with AbbVie Inc., AstraZeneca AB, and Astellas Pharma Inc. for the development and commercialization of linaclotide. The company was formerly known as Microbia, Inc. and changed its name to Ironwood Pharmaceuticals, Inc. in April 2008. Ironwood Pharmaceuticals, Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts.

classification_meta.logic_summary: Ironwood Pharmaceuticals is a biotechnology company that develops and commercializes therapies for gastrointestinal and rare diseases, primarily generating revenue from product sales of LINZESS and CONSTELLA.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** Ironwood’s core franchise is experiencing exceptional momentum, driven entirely by LINZESS. U.S. demand remains robust in both adult and pediatric irritable bowel syndrome with constipation and functional constipation, underpinned by favorable net pricing. The commercial story is further strengthened by a near-term regulatory catalyst: the FDA has accepted a supplemental new drug application for LINZESS in younger pediatric patients with functional constipation and granted priority review. Beyond the LINZESS lifecycle, the company is advancing a pipeline asset, apraglutide, into Phase 3 for short bowel syndrome with intestinal failure, broadening its future therapeutic reach.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership has consistently signaled confidence, issuing and then reaffirming a positive full-year revenue outlook that exceeded market expectations and drove a sharp stock rally. The organization is executing effectively on multiple fronts—delivering a quarterly revenue beat, sustaining LINZESS growth, and progressing the pediatric label expansion that is nearing a decision date. Concurrently, management is moving apraglutide toward site initiations for a confirmatory trial, demonstrating disciplined capital allocation toward life‑cycle management and pipeline development. This execution track record is reinforcing market credibility and validating the strategic focus.

# Ironwood Stock Rises 27% on Upbeat Revenue Guidance for 2026

January 05, 2026 — 10:28 am EST

Written by Zacks Equity Research for Zacks->

Shares of Ironwood Pharmaceuticals IRWD were up 26.7% on Jan. 2 after the company announced upbeat revenue guidance for 2026. The company maintained its revenue guidance for full-year 2025, which it had provided in November 2025.

Ironwood’s sole marketed product, Linzess (linaclotide), is approved for the treatment of irritable bowel syndrome with constipation (IBS-C) in adults and pediatric patients aged seven years and above. The drug is also approved for treating functional constipation (“FC”) in children and adolescents aged six to 17 years.

In the past six months, shares of Ironwood have skyrocketed 498.9% compared with the industry’s increase of 6%.
